Although there are many books on getting baby to sleep, Sleep Deprived No More focuses on someone else who isn't getting any rest -- the mom! Organized trimester by trimester both during and after pregnancy, this guide is straightforward, accessibly written, and easy to navigate so moms can quickly get the help -- and rest -- they need.
